logistics.title: Courier accounts
logistics.intro: Nepal Can Move accounts: each shop's own, and DripNepal's account for shops that staff allowed on it. Credentials are never shown.
logistics.column.name: Name
logistics.empty.heading: No courier account yet
logistics.empty.body: No shop has added a Nepal Can Move account, and DripNepal has no account of its own yet.
logistics.create.title: Add DripNepal's NCM account
logistics.create.description: Shops that staff allow on it can book with it. NCM checks the token before anyone can book.
logistics.create.name: Name (required)
logistics.create.name_rule: Enter a name of 2 to 80 characters.
logistics.create.reference_help: The account name or number in NCM's portal, to find it there later.
logistics.create.token_help: From NCM's portal. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
logistics.create.token_rule: Enter the token of 8 to 200 characters, without spaces.
logistics.create.done: Account added. It shows "Checking with courier" until NCM answers.
logistics.status.reason_rule: Enter a reason of 3 to 500 characters.
logistics.status.suspend.title: Suspend {name}?
logistics.status.suspend.consequence: Shops can't book with it until it is resumed. Parcels already booked keep moving.
logistics.status.resume.title: Resume {name}?
logistics.status.resume.consequence: NCM checks the account again before shops can book with it.
logistics.status.resume.done: {name} is being checked with NCM again.
logistics.status.disable.title: Disable {name}?
logistics.status.disable.consequence: Its credentials are erased for good and no shop can book with it. This can't be undone.
